## Featured Highlights

* **[<span class="author-name">American Statistical Association News – 2025</span>](https://magazine.amstat.org/blog/2025/06/02/awardees/)**
    * Lester R. Curtin Award – 2025
    * Recognized among recipients of the **Lester R. Curtin Award** by the American Statistical Association.

* **[<span class="author-name">SIP 2025 Scholarship Award</span>](https://stat4pharma.org/scholarship.html)**
    * Statistics in Pharmaceuticals (SIP) Scholarship Award, University of Connecticut – 2025
    * Recipient of the **Statistics in Pharmaceuticals Scholarship Award**, supporting graduate students in statistics for pharmaceutical research and offering a platform to present my work to a wider professional audience.

* **[<span class="author-name">University of New Mexico Outstanding Student Recognition</span>](https://www.instagram.com/unmafro/p/DJKe6LWvQJe/)**
    * **Excellence in Teaching** and **Student of the Year** Awards – 2025
    * Recognized by the University of New Mexico for excellence in teaching, service, leadership, and community engagement.

* **[<span class="author-name">American Statistical Association News – 2024</span>](https://asabiopreport.substack.com/p/transition-report)**
    * Biopharmaceutical Section Scholarship Award – 2024
    * The Biopharmaceutical Section of the American Statistical Association recognized a student with the **Biopharmaceutical Section Scholarship Award** based on notable research, academic achievement, and applied project work related to biopharmaceutical statistics. The award also considers overall academic performance, leadership, volunteerism, and service.

* **[<span class="author-name">Zancada Graduate Fellowship</span>](https://research.unm.edu/zancada/)**
    * Fellowship Recognition – 2024
    * Awarded the **Zancada Graduate Fellowship** by the University of New Mexico’s Office of the Vice President for Research for excellence in research and leadership.
